usedFor: CAMB.AI turns text and video into other languages with “Create Translation” and “End To End Dubbing”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated File in specific folder” in Google Drive, then “Create Translation” in CAMB.AI
bestTemplate.why: A file dropped in a folder gets translated, so other languages appear without anyone starting it.

watchOut: A trigger that fires on updated files as well as new ones will run “Create Translation” again after each edit.
